symptom: CI passes locally but fails in CI
likely_cause: Shell quoting difference; missing env var; TTY assumption
what_to_recheck: Check shell quoting in all YAML; check stdin handling; diff env vars
fix_pattern: Use set -euo pipefail; quote all variables; add -T to docker compose run

symptom: Test passes alone but fails in suite
what_to_recheck: Run in isolation; run full suite in random order
fix_pattern: Use fixtures; tear down state in setUp/tearDown

symptom: SQL returns wrong count after migration
likely_cause: Missing FINAL clause on ReplacingMergeTree; late-arriving data
what_to_recheck: Run OPTIMIZE TABLE FINAL; check watermark logic
fix_pattern: Add FINAL to SELECT; add late-data buffer window

likely_cause: Unintentional seed change; data leakage from new shuffle
what_to_recheck: Compare data splits; compare random seeds
fix_pattern: Freeze seed; assert split sizes match prior run

symptom: Export model fails inference but trains fine
likely_cause: Opset incompatibility; missing companion file; wrong input shape
what_to_recheck: Check opset version; check all artifact files present; run forward pass
fix_pattern: Use rglob for artifacts; set opset explicitly; add numerical parity test

symptom: Deploy works in staging fails in prod
likely_cause: Env var not set in prod; different image tag; DB migration not run
what_to_recheck: Diff env vars staging vs prod; check image tag; check migration status
fix_pattern: Run migration checklist before deploy; use same image tag

symptom: DAG runs once but breaks on catchup
likely_cause: Missing idempotency; state not reset between runs
what_to_recheck: Run DAG twice on same date; check for APPEND vs OVERWRITE
fix_pattern: Use partition overwrite; add idempotency check in operator

symptom: Null pointer in prod not in dev
likely_cause: Different data in prod has NULL values dev data lacks
what_to_recheck: Run null boundary checks on prod-like data
fix_pattern: Add IS NULL guards; use COALESCE

symptom: Background job succeeds in test but hangs in prod
likely_cause: Missing timeout; TTY/stdin issue; DB connection pool exhausted
what_to_recheck: Add timeout; check connection limits; check stdin flags
fix_pattern: Set connection pool size; add timeout param; use --no-TTY
